question: In 2021, who among the following was awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Indian freestyle wrestler **Ravi Kumar **Dahiya took up a silver medal in the **57 kg division **at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• Dahiya is **three-time** **Asian champion **as well as **2019 **World Wrestling Championship bronze **medalist**.
 
• He won **gold medal** in **men's 57kg** freestyle **wrestling **division at the **2022 Birmingham Commonwealth **Games in **Birmingham**, **England**.
 
• He received the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna **award in **2021**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **PV Sindhu:**

 
 
• **​**A badminton player from India is **Pusarla Venkata** **Sindhu**.
 
• Sindhu, who is regarded as one of the India's most accomplished **athletes**, has won medals at numerous competitions, including the Olympics and the BWF circuit, as well as a gold at the 2019 World Championships.
 
 
 
• **Jwala Gutta:**
 
 
• ​Jwala Gutta is an Indian badminton player who was born on **September 7, 1983.**
 
• She began **representing India **at **international competitions **in women's doubles and mixed doubles in the late **1990s.**
 
• She reached at **No. 6** in the world rankings and has a total of **316 match victories **across both disciplines, the most of any Indian.
 
 
 
• **Tara Iyer: **
 
 
• Indian tennis player Tara Iyer has won **one doubles championship **and **four singles titles** in the **ITF**.**​**
 
 

d5:T
